entities.summary: Grzegorz Kacała, born 15 March 1966, is a Polish former professional rugby union and rugby league footballer who played in the 1990s, and has coached rugby union in the 2000s and 2010s. In rugby union, his position was in the back row, usually number eight. He is the only Polish player to have been on a Heineken Cup-winning team, in 1997 with CA Brive. He was named man of the match in the final against Leicester Tigers. He currently coaches in Poland at Lechia Gdańsk (2009/2010). He also played with Cardiff RFC. He started his professional career in the Polish League.
